{{Quote|Greetings, gentlebeings. I am Wing Commander Wedge Antilles. In this lecture, I am going to discuss the importance of starfighters in the Alliance's strategy and tactics.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="RASB" />}}
'''Alliance Strategy and Tactics Lecture 137''' was the one hundred thirty-seventh [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-lecture in the [[Alliance Strategy and Tactics Lecture series]]. In it, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] offered an overview of [[Starfighter Command (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Starfighter Command]] and [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]].
